name: Collapse
summary: A panel that opens and closes. It is a real disclosure, so the browser does the opening and the closing and the state survives a reload.
summaryZh: 一块能展开也能收起来的面板。它是一个真正的展开控件,所以开关由浏览器负责,展开的状态也能扛过一次刷新。

variants.name: Plain
variants.note: The panel carries no frame of its own; two panels in a row are separated by the rule the second one draws above itself, so a group needs no extra element. The base class on its own is this, and the modifier paints the same thing so the class list can name it.

variants.name: Card
variants.note: Every panel is a card of its own, with a frame and a fill.

sizes.name: Small
sizes.note: The title takes the caption size and the panel is padded tightly.

sizes.name: Medium
sizes.note: The default size. The base class is already this size, so it needs no modifier.

sizes.name: Large
sizes.note: The title takes the title size and the panel is padded loosely.

states.name: Open
states.note: The panel is open. The browser announces it, and the arrow turns over.

states.name: Focus visible
states.note: The ring goes on the header, because the header is what the reader is on.

states.name: Disabled
states.note: The panel cannot be opened. A disclosure is not a form control, so it cannot carry the disabled attribute itself — the wrapper writes aria-disabled instead.

states.name: Arrow at the start
states.note: The arrow sits at the start of the header rather than at its end.

parts.name: Header
parts.note: The summary. It is the element the browser turns into a disclosure button, so it carries the focus and the keyboard.

parts.name: Arrow
parts.note: The mark that says the panel opens. It is drawn from two borders, so it carries no text of its own.

parts.name: Content
parts.note: The body of the panel. The browser hides it while the panel is closed.

props.name: open
props.description: Opens the panel. It is the native open attribute on the details, so the browser keeps the state.
props.descriptionZh: 展开面板。它是 details 上的原生 open 属性,所以状态由浏览器记着。

props.name: variant
props.description: The shape of the panel. The plain run is the base class on its own; the card run adds um-collapse--card.
props.descriptionZh: 面板的样子。无边框就是只写基类;卡片式再加上 um-collapse--card。

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the title and of the padding around the panel.
props.descriptionZh: 标题的尺寸,以及面板四周留白的大小。

props.name: title
props.description: The text of the header. A panel with no text needs an accessible name of its own.
props.descriptionZh: 标题栏上的文字。没有文字的面板也得有自己的可访问名称。

props.name: model-value
props.description: Whether the panel is open, bound with v-model in Vue. Leave it out and the `open` prop is the state; bind it and the panel answers to the binding.
props.descriptionZh: 面板是否展开,在 Vue 里用 v-model 绑定。不传就以 open 属性为准;传了就以绑定为准。

props.name: disabled
props.description: Makes the panel inert: it cannot be opened, and it takes the derived disabled colour.
props.descriptionZh: 让面板不可用:打不开,并且用派生的禁用色。

props.name: expand-icon-position
props.description: Which end of the header the arrow sits on. The ends are written logically, so a right-to-left reader gets the other side; the end run is the base class on its own.
props.descriptionZh: 箭头放在标题栏的哪一头。两头是按阅读方向写的,所以从右往左读的读者拿到的是另一头;放在末尾就是只写基类。

slots.name: default
slots.description: The body of the panel: what the panel hides and shows.
slots.descriptionZh: 面板的内容:面板收起和展开时露出来的那部分。

events.name: toggle
events.description: Fires when the panel opens or closes. It is the browser's own event on the details — the library installs no listener.
events.descriptionZh: 面板展开或收起时触发。这是 details 上的浏览器原生事件 —— 库没有安装任何监听器。

events.name: update:modelValue
events.description: Fires when the panel opens or closes, carrying the new state. This is the event `v-model` listens to.
events.descriptionZh: 面板展开或收起时触发,携带新的状态。v-model 监听的就是这个事件。

a11y.notes: The panel is a real <details> and the header is a real <summary>, so the browser announces the header as a disclosure button and says whether the panel is open. The keyboard is the browser's own: Tab reaches the header, Enter or Space opens the panel. The arrow is drawn from borders, so it carries no text — the state is announced by the browser, not by the mark.
a11y.notesZh: 面板是一个真正的 <details>,标题栏是一个真正的 <summary>,所以浏览器会把标题栏播报成展开按钮,并说明面板是开着还是关着。键盘也是浏览器自己的:Tab 走到标题栏上,Enter 或空格展开面板。那个箭头是边框画出来的,所以它自己不带文字 —— 状态是浏览器播报的,不是那个记号播报的。

examples.title: A group of panels
examples.description: Two panels in a row. The rule between them is drawn by the panel below, so a group of panels needs no element around it. The first one is open.
examples.descriptionZh: 一排两块面板。它们之间的线是下面那块画的,所以一组面板不需要外面再套一个元素。第一块是开着的。
examples.markup:
Shipping

Orders leave the warehouse on the next working day.

Returns

Anything unused can go back within thirty days.

examples.title: Cards
examples.description: Each panel is a card of its own, with a frame and a fill. Only the modifier class changes; the markup is the same.
examples.descriptionZh: 每块面板都是自己的一张卡片,带外框和底色。变的只有那个修饰类,标记是同一份。
examples.markup:
Shipping

Orders leave the warehouse on the next working day.

Returns

Anything unused can go back within thirty days.

notes: A panel is a disclosure and not a menu: the browser owns the open state, so it stays open across a reload and the reader gets the collapsed and expanded announcement for free. The rule between two plain panels is drawn by the panel below as a top border, so a group of panels needs no wrapper and a group of one has no stray line above it. The arrow is drawn from two borders, so it takes the header's own colour and a disabled panel dims with it.
notesZh: 面板是一个展开控件,不是一个菜单:开关状态归浏览器管,所以它在刷新之后还是开着的,读者也能免费得到「已折叠」「已展开」的播报。两块无边框面板之间的线是由下面那块画的上边框,所以一组面板不需要外层元素,只有一块的时候也不会多出一道孤零零的线。那个箭头是用两条边框画出来的,所以它跟着标题栏自己的颜色走。
